name: Spare the Dying
description:
You touch a living creature that has 0 Endurance. The if the creature is dying, it is no longer dying.

Describe how you bring them back from the brink.

improvements.name: Revivify
improvements.description: You may touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 0 Endurance and remains unconscious. This spell can’t return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.
